description: Output module converting modular level to balanced line level, with a headphone amplifier

params.text: Sets the level of the left and right outputs; with the pointer at the left channel lamp they are at +4dBu unity
Sets the level of the headphone output, set independently of the balanced level

inputs.text: The left input; unpatched, the right input takes this signal too

outputs.text: Both channels driven out of one unbalanced headphone jack, in parallel with the balanced outputs
The left input as a balanced differential line level signal
The right input as a balanced differential line level signal

notes: Each of the three outputs is a two channel cable, carrying the left signal on channel 1 and the right on channel 2, so one cable takes the pair to a stereo destination
A càrn standing immediately to the left with Allow Chaining switched on sums its stereo mix into the left and right inputs
